value.rationale: Idempotent endomorphism image dimensions and distinct retract subalgebras are canonical invariants, not arbitrary slices. Complete spectra separate abelian versus smaller-star retracts, with exact map-to-image fibre counts. The class imbalance explains a new asymptotic phenomenon: almost all retractions are abelian, yet rank has a nondegenerate four-phase discrete Gaussian rather than collapsing to two ranks. This is structural information about a natural infinite graph-Lie family.
